name: Necromancers of Grixis
description: Mages of Grixis who wield darkness and animate corpses as soldiers and weapons.

timeline.summary: Meren spends years in the deadlands of Grixis, learning from necromancers and discovering how to Borrow the dead.
timeline.quote: she learned to revitalize the deceased
